source.name: presentation-ksequence-cambio
source.status: Extracted visual reference; not a replacement for approved brand foundations.

patterns.purpose: Open with one large claim and one luminous focal object
patterns.recipe: Use a 55/45 split, oversized left-aligned Figtree, restrained grid, peripheral red-violet glow, and thin orbital rings.
patterns.motion: Float only the focal object on a slow loop; keep copy and chrome still.

patterns.purpose: Contrast two foundations, principles, or strategic pillars
patterns.recipe: Use two equal dark fields with a thin accent rail, one micro-diagram, and no more than one paragraph per field.
patterns.motion: Build diagrams in 400-700 ms with a short stagger; loop only a simple signal.

patterns.purpose: Create a brief narrative reset before a new chapter
patterns.recipe: Place one short monospaced message inside a generous light window over a faint grid.
patterns.motion: Type at a readable pace, pause after the opening phrase, then use a single high-impact transition.

patterns.purpose: Show one origin becoming several connected initiatives
patterns.recipe: Place the origin left, a division core near center, and ordered descendants right; use gradient connectors and aligned portraits or icons.
patterns.motion: Draw connectors first, migrate markers second, reveal destinations last.

patterns.purpose: Introduce a team or person through an orbital portrait system
patterns.recipe: Use a quiet light field, circular portraits, thin orbital rules, and one small red plus one violet marker.
patterns.motion: Use only slow 4-5 second portrait drift and a much slower orbit rotation.

patterns.purpose: Build an immersive image-led chapter with concise copy
patterns.recipe: Use one full-bleed photograph, a directional black overlay, an eyebrow, a large claim, and minimal metadata.
patterns.motion: Allow gentle image drift or grain; never animate essential copy.

patterns.purpose: Tell a human story through one collage or structured gallery
patterns.recipe: Choose either a composed editorial collage or a clean asymmetric image grid; keep crops and borders consistent.
patterns.motion: Use entry reveals only when order matters; otherwise keep the gallery static.

patterns.purpose: Explain practices, channels, systems, or operating principles
patterns.recipe: Use warm Gelo paper, Chumbo type, hairline rules, disciplined rows, and compact diagrams instead of decorative cards.
patterns.motion: Reveal rows or connectors in reading order with 80-150 ms staggers.

patterns.purpose: Present a set of anecdotes, decisions, or cases as an editorial wall
patterns.recipe: Use varied paper fields with very small rotations, tape details, one dominant story, and clear author markers.
patterns.motion: Use subtle hover or opening motion only; preserve legibility over playfulness.

patterns.purpose: Compare a family of objects whose scale is meaningful
patterns.recipe: Map area to quantity, separate families by hue, provide a scale rail, and let labels stay outside the objects.
patterns.motion: Stagger object arrival, pulse the core gently, and make filters settle in under 600 ms.

patterns.purpose: Explain an analogy by aligning two step-by-step sequences
patterns.recipe: Stack two parallel rails with matching grammar, highlight the predicted output, and place the shared logic between them.
patterns.motion: Reveal tokens in order, draw the connector, then reveal the outcome.

patterns.purpose: Pair a strong claim with several views of one reusable context
patterns.recipe: Keep the claim in the left third and the interactive or scenario panel in the right two-thirds; reuse the same frame for every scenario.
patterns.motion: Switch scenarios with a 350-500 ms lateral or opacity transition; animate only the changed measure.

patterns.purpose: Contrast a fragmented current state with a connected future state
patterns.recipe: Use symmetric outer fields, a small transformation engine at center, muted current-state nodes, and a clearer future-state system.
patterns.motion: Let one data point traverse the center; keep ambient orbits slow.

patterns.purpose: Present model or option results with an explicit takeaway
patterns.recipe: Lead with the conclusion, use one or two disciplined tables, bold the winner, and add a short directional note such as higher or lower is better.
patterns.motion: Use a quick panel change only when tabs expose alternate result families.

patterns.purpose: Show an iterative cycle plus version or maturity progression
patterns.recipe: Combine a few top milestones, one large loop with labeled stages, and a separate version rail.
patterns.motion: Move one runner around the loop slowly; reveal nodes once and keep sparks sparse.

patterns.purpose: Summarize three capabilities and connect them to a wider ecosystem
patterns.recipe: Use three equal capability scenes with cropped diagram-atlas art, then a full-width integration band underneath.
patterns.motion: Float decorative atlas art 3-7 px over 6-8 seconds; keep labels still.

patterns.purpose: Turn a sequence, investigation, or decision into an evidence-based case
patterns.recipe: Pair a narrative claim with an evidence timeline, bounded options, and a response area; distinguish known facts from hypotheses.
patterns.motion: Reveal evidence before choices and use a restrained selected state rather than celebration effects.
